findings.title: D4 VRWM 22 V sits below the 26.4 V worst-case input
findings.claim: The TVS starts to conduct within the normal input range and leaks or overheats.
findings.fix: Use the 28 V standoff part and recheck the clamp against downstream abs max.

findings.title: Thermal pad of U3 has two vias
findings.claim: Two vias under the exposed pad give about 60 C/W.
